entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CS9314 and CS9298 should not be created when compiling a .cs file containing #: or #! lines #80906
  • FileBasedProgram: #: directives should be respected for specifying references #80905
  • The IDE should not allow setting breakpoints on interface property getters and setters #80903
    Backlog
  • The codefix offering other candidates for wrongly-written identifiers should consider permutations of camelCaseParts #80902
    Backlog
  • Duplicate results for Find All Refs on a record primary constructor parameter #80901

Closed

  • Sub Main #80909
  • Building Roslyn with analyzers slows build by 2-7x #38017
  • Incorrect binding to a property instead of type when property is nullable #80904
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11125.25 #80900

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix VariablesDeclaredWalker with recursive patterns #80910
    Area-Compilers
  • Let tuple/anonymous member name inference see through null suppression operator #80908
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Improve compiler error recovery for null coalesce assignment operator #80907
    Area-Compilers, Community
